meta.source: UESP wiki (en.uesp.net): Skyrim:Ingredients overview plus individual item pages and creation pages, all read 2026-10-01
meta.edition: Skyrim Special Edition / Anniversary Edition (base game, all DLC, and the Creation Club content listed on UESP)
meta.objectIDFormat: low 3 bytes of the full formID, 8-digit uppercase hex: e.g. 00106e1b -> 0x000106E1B, FExxx82A -> 0x0000082A, 0100306D -> 0x0000306D
notes: UESP's Skyrim:Ingredients page claims '73 ingredients are added by the following Creations', but its CC table actually holds 74 rows: the extra row is the Bloodchill Manor Nightshade variant (xx042A61), which belongs to none of the listed creations. Additionally, UESP's Category:Skyrim-Creation_Club-Ingredients contains 'Healing Salts' (Bittercup, FExxxF86), missing from the ingredients overview table entirely. This file includes all 75 unique CC-related ingredients.

Flame Stalk exists as two distinct INGR records with identical effects: one from Rare Curios (FExxx82A) and one from Saints & Seducers (xx095E23); both are listed under formids. UESP notes the two versions do not stack in the inventory.

Rot Scale, Screaming Maw, and Thorn Hook are listed under Saints & Seducers in the ingredients overview, but their UESP item pages state the INGR records were added to Update.esm by Special Edition Patch 1.5.97; they are only obtainable in-game with Saints & Seducers (plants in the Solitude Sewers). Their plugin is recorded as Update.esm.
The task brief's example gave Fishing as ccBGSSSE001-Fish.esl; UESP's Skyrim:Fishing page says ccBGSSSE001-Fish.esm. UESP was used.
CC plugin filenames are exactly as displayed on UESP infoboxes; most render all-lowercase there (Windows plugin filenames are case-insensitive, so this does not affect load-order matching).
Mort Flesh (Plague of the Dead, FExxx80C) and Hunger Tongue (Rare Curios, FExxx80C) share the same objectID in different plugins; this is normal and not a conflict.
Flame Stalk (Rare Curios) carries a full-plugin-style ID xx095E23 only in its Saints & Seducers record; the Rare Curios record is the light-plugin FExxx82A.
Every ingredient has exactly 4 effects, in UESP's canonical order and naming.
Healing Salts (Bittercup) is unused content; UESP calls it an exact duplicate of Salt Pile (same 4 effects).

Farengar's Frost Salt and Fine-Cut Void Salts share their INGR records with Frost Salts (0x0003AD5F) and Void Salts (0x0003AD60) respectively; both names therefore map to the same (plugin, objectID) key.
No formIDs or effects were invented: every entry traces to a UESP page actually read.
